name: method-figure-loop-codex
title_zh: 论文方法图先画成可回放程序，再让子代理挑刺
tagline_zh: 审稿人总说图看不清流程？这张图自己会拆解成命名步骤回放，导出 SVG 后还有只盯像素的 Codex 子代理逼你讲清…
tagline_en: Reviewers say your figure hides the flow? This one replays its own build in named stages, exports SVG, then a.
desc_en: ALIGN for paper figures — draw a method-overview figure as an executable p5.js program that replays its own construction in named stages, exports SVG, and improves through pixel-only independent Codex subagent review whose gate is 'explain the method back from the figure alone, and is it worth looking at'. The method sets the relationships the figure must show, the chosen visual identity sets how
why_zh: 把图变成可执行程序，构造顺序即叙事顺序；子代理只看像素不看代码，逼你把方法讲给外行听。
why_en: The figure is an executable program, so construction order is narrative order. The subagent sees only pixels, forcing you to.
limit_zh: 只服务论文方法总览图，不画数据图/流程图；需要会改 p5.js 代码；子代理要联网调 Codex API，离线装不了。
limit_en: Only for paper method-overview figures, not data or flow diagrams. Requires editing p5.js code, online Codex API for the subagent, and manual SVG.
